listing.title: Noctalia: Dream Journal
listing.short_description: Keep your dreams close, explore their symbols, and notice what returns.
listing.full_description:
What if your dreams did not have to disappear when morning came?

Noctalia turns each nighttime memory into a page of your dream journal. A few words are enough to save a scene, a feeling, or a symbol—then return to what stayed with you whenever you choose.

KEEP THE STORY OF YOUR NIGHTS
• Write a dream when you wake up or use optional voice dictation.
• Add the emotions, symbols, and details you remember.
• Keep every dream in a private, visual journal that is easy to revisit.

WATCH YOUR DREAM WORLD TAKE SHAPE
• Give form to a dream’s atmosphere with a dream-inspired illustration.
• Revisit your memories like chapters in a story that belongs only to you.
• Search your dream diary, save favorites, and keep meaningful dreams close.

DISCOVER WHAT KEEPS RETURNING
• Notice emotions, themes, and dream symbols across your nights.
• Follow recurring patterns that connect more than one dream.
• See how your dream journal changes over time, at your own pace.

FOLLOW THE DREAM FURTHER
• Ask questions about a detail that still intrigues you.
• Explore the symbol dictionary and guides when you want to go deeper.
• Discover dream interpretation perspectives without forcing your experience into one fixed meaning.

Noctalia helps you remember, notice, and reflect. Its analyses and dream interpretations offer possible perspectives. They are not a diagnosis, medical or psychological advice, or a prediction.

Open your dream journal and let the story of your nights unfold, one dream at a time.
